long_description:
Elise and V of LVNDRHAUS Wellness is taking over The Dojo.Society for a full day devoted to movement, breath, nourishment, and restoration.

this session is designed to help us ground into a new season with a sense of self-trust and expansion, with an introduction to Kemetic yoga, Kundalini yoga, and offerings from their apothecary.

"Our intention is to bring awareness to the mind - body connection, and to educate and equip the collective with tools for staying centered, aligned, and empowered.
